chunks: When they entered to Joseph, he gave his parents a place of honour, and said: 'Enter Egypt, if God wills, in peace.'

key_terms.آوَى: gave shelter / gave a place of honour

ai.seo_question: How did Prophet Joseph welcome his parents when they entered Egypt?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Joseph (AS) facilitates the full family reunion in Egypt, inviting his parents and brother to enter with peace and security, explicitly attributing their safety to God's will ('Insha'Allah'). Shia scholars highlight this as a model of filial piety and political wisdom, demonstrating how Joseph used his high status to restore dignity to his family while maintaining divine reliance. The phrase 'Aaminin' underscores the divine guarantee of safety, reinforcing the theme of God's plan unfolding through human agency.
